title: Integrative analyses of metastatic cancer transcriptome reveal clinically distinct cellular States and ecosystems.
authors: Zhang, Can; Li, Si; Yu, Yun; Chi, Meng; Yuan, Ziming; Wang, Kun
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习框架EcoTyper分析转移癌转录组，识别细胞状态和生态系统，仅含转录因子富集分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Determining the diverse cellular states and their organization into cellular ecosystems that make up metastatic tumor is vital for elucidating the biological and prognostic diversity of cancer. However, large-scale studies profiling the clinical relevance of these cellular states and ecotypes are still lacking in metastatic cancers. In this study, we used EcoTyper, a machine learning framework, to comprehensively analyze transcriptomes from 2822 metastatic cancer patient samples covering 25 cancer types, enabling characterization of the fundamental cellular states and tumor ecosystems integral to metastatic cancer. We identified 45 distinct cellular states across 12 cell types and validated their robustness in validation cohorts. We observed that they differed in functional and prognostic associations. Survival analysis revealed that the clinically relevant cellular states, highlighting their promise as predictors of clinical outcomes. Functional enrichment analysis exhibited that the marker genes of cellular states were significantly enriched in cancer hallmark and immune-related pathways. In addition, our analysis identified five ecotypes associated with different clinical outcomes. Transcription factor enrichment analysis revealed key transcription factors (i.e. SPIB, SRF, and NR1D1) that were significantly associated with patient clinical outcomes. In conclusion, this study provided a high-resolution landscape of cellular states and ecosystems in metastatic tumors, offering new potential targets for the development of cancer treatment strategies and prognostic assessment.
abstract_zh: 确定构成转移性肿瘤的多样细胞状态及其组织成细胞生态系统的机制，对于阐明癌症的生物学和预后多样性至关重要。然而，在转移性癌症中，大规模研究这些细胞状态和生态型的临床相关性仍显不足。本研究利用机器学习框架EcoTyper，全面分析了涵盖25种癌症类型的2822例转移性癌症患者样本的转录组，从而能够表征转移性癌症中基本的细胞状态和肿瘤生态系统。我们识别出12种细胞类型中的45种不同细胞状态，并在验证队列中确认了其稳健性。观察到这些状态在功能和预后关联上存在差异。生存分析揭示了具有临床相关性的细胞状态，凸显其作为临床结局预测因子的潜力。功能富集分析显示，细胞状态的标记基因显著富集于癌症标志性和免疫相关通路中。此外，我们的分析识别出五种与不同临床结局相关的生态型。转录因子富集分析揭示了与患者临床结局显著相关的关键转录因子（如SPIB、SRF和NR1D1）。总之，本研究提供了转移性肿瘤中细胞状态和生态系统的高分辨率图谱，为癌症治疗策略开发和预后评估提供了新的潜在靶点。
